publication_scope: local commits only; no push, tag, release, email, author contact, or external message
epistemic_status: post-confirmatory falsification after Day 13 safety results were observed

claims_under_attack.claim: the unchanged benign-selected K16 set causally transfers to deception and harmfulness
the selected set contains a shared downstream actuator rather than only unrelated concept-specific effects
semantic concept naming with cross-safety spillover, not generic monitoring language, controls evasion
the causal effect is not an artifact of outliers, pooling, thresholds, indexing, hook placement, or selection multiplicity
behavior is comparatively preserved for deception but materially perturbed for harmfulness

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap independently within safety concept and class, identical to the frozen Day 13 estimator

outlier_dependence.leave_one_out: recompute selected and selected-minus-random rescue and induction after deleting each positive example in turn
outlier_dependence.worst_case_rule: for each concept, direction, and estimand, delete the ceiling fraction of positive examples with the largest favorable per-example numerator
outlier_dependence.median_of_means_assignment: lowest SHA-256 order of day14-mom:{concept}:{example_id}, then round-robin into five groups
outlier_dependence.robustness_gate: leave-one-out minima and every 20-percent worst-case-deletion selected and selected-minus-random point estimate remain strictly above zero

thresholds.classification_rule: probe score strictly greater than threshold
thresholds.report: TPR and FPR for normal, correct trigger, selected/random rescue, and selected/random induction; threshold results are secondary because the central causal fraction is continuous

alternative_pooling.gate: the descriptive selected and selected-minus-random rescue and induction intervals remain above zero for both concepts under all four archived pooling rules

data_leakage.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace, strip surrounding whitespace
data_leakage.near_duplicate_metric: word five-gram Jaccard on normalized prompt plus response
data_leakage.major_failure: any exact normalized prompt-response or source path/index identity across discovery, validation, and safety phases
data_leakage.flag_only: near-duplicate score at or above 0.8 without exact identity requires manual reporting but is not automatically leakage

multiple_comparisons.statistic: positive-example rescue numerator divided by each concept suppression gap
multiple_comparisons.procedure: 20,000 example-level sign-flip permutations with a maximum absolute studentized mean statistic across all 68 candidates
multiple_comparisons.report: familywise-adjusted p-values for discovery candidates and whether each selected candidate survives; the frozen K16 safety test is reported separately because safety data did not select the set

machinery_audit.data: two lowest-example-id positive all-caps validation examples
checks: block-12 output equals layer-13 residual input
block-12 output equals model hidden_states[13] on response tokens
runner attention-output capture equals the raw post-attention-layernorm module output
runner MLP-output capture equals the raw post-feedforward-layernorm module output
all 16 runner head captures reconstruct the raw o_proj input
full and truncated block-12 probe scores agree
same-shape identity patches at resid-pre, attention, MLP, head, and block sites preserve scores
normal block-12 replacement into the triggered run reaches the normal monitor activation
response token IDs and masks are exact across paired conditions
machinery_audit.gate: every structural, equivalence, identity, alignment, and cleanup check passes

subset.selection: lowest SHA-256 values of day14-causal:{example_id} independently for deception and harmfulness positives

causal_falsification.execution: all-response-token natural activation transplant with truncated scoring at block 12; selected membership is never changed or reranked
causal_falsification.null_gate: on the frozen 32-example subset, selected K16 rescue and induction point estimates exceed the maximum of all five seeded layer-count-matched head-null estimates independently for deception and harmfulness
causal_falsification.non_equivalent_control_limitation: same-layer whole-MLP controls do not exist because each layer has only one whole-MLP candidate; seeded K16 nulls are layer-count-matched head sets, while MLP and shifted-site controls are reported separately

clean_reproduction.isolation: detached temporary git worktree and fresh Python process; verified read-only symlinks to the existing model, probes, and pinned virtual environment
clean_reproduction.outputs: results/day-14/clean-reproduction; never overwrite the canonical Day 13 archive
clean_reproduction.gate: exact 1,944-row key grid, identical support classification, maximum absolute difference at most 0.002 for every primary point estimate, and all frozen interval lower-bound decisions unchanged; byte-identical archives are stronger evidence but not required
